'''Business and economy'''
*[[Frigidaire]] issues a [[Product recall|recall]] for 330,000 [[refrigerator|mini-fridges]] for fire risks, after previously recalling 634,000 last year. [https://apnews.com/article/minifridge-recall-frigidaire-fire-hazards-a45ebfd94631a55eb0707976025f0cad (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2026 Utrecht explosions]]
**At least four people are injured and several buildings collapse following an explosion in the [[Utrecht]] city centre in the [[Netherlands]]. Authorities suspect it to be a [[gas explosion]]. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2598303-vier-gewonden-bij-brand-in-centrum-utrecht-na-explosies-meerdere-panden-ingestort (NOS <small>in Dutch</small>)] [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2026/01/15/-gigantic-explosion-fire-in-dutch-city-of-utrecht-one-hurt-authorities (AFP via Al Arabiya)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cm2xv0w07dgo (BBC News)]
*At least 19 people are killed and hundreds are evacuated across [[South Africa]] in flooding caused by torrential rains in several [[Provinces of South Africa|provinces]], including [[Limpopo]] and [[Mpumalanga]]. [https://apnews.com/article/south-africa-floods-weather-kruger-national-park-rains-4611db4d92141aa5f071a1efea626424 (AP)]
*Two people are killed when a [[Crane (machine)|construction crane]] collapses onto the [[Rama II Road]] in [[Samut Sakhon]], [[Thailand]], while the [[Anutin cabinet|Thai government]] moves to cancel contracts, blacklist the same [[Government contractor|contractor]], and suspend about a dozen of its state projects following [[2026 Sikhio train disaster|a separate crane accident the previous day]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c20g7n7yd9do (BBC News)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/another-crane-collapses-thailand-killing-2-people-police-say-2026-01-15/ (Reuters)]

**[[France|French]] [[President of France|president]] [[Emmanuel Macron]] announces the deployment of additional [[French Armed Forces|military forces]] to [[Greenland]] after a [[Secretariat-General for National Defence and Security (France)|Defense Council]] meeting. **[[Japan]] and the [[Philippines]] sign a [[defense pact]] to mutually allow tax-free provision of [[ammunition]], fuel, food, and other forms of aid. [https://apnews.com/article/philippines-japan-defense-pact-china-7835402a0a3b9b108cd4e1edf0051bcf (AP)]

**[[Faraj Al-Bahsani]] is dismissed from [[Yemen]]'s [[Presidential Leadership Council]], becoming the last [[United Arab Emirates]]-backed member to leave the body. [https://www.newarab.com/news/yemen-presidential-body-sacks-last-uae-backed-member (''The New Arab'')]
